description: Get the audience retention curve of one of the user's own published YouTube videos, read live from YouTube Analytics: points of ratio (elapsed share of the video, 0.01-1.0), audienceWatchRatio and relativeRetentionPerformance (vs. YouTube videos of similar length). Pass account and video from a youtube get_post_metrics row. Only the user's own channel is ever queried; a 403 YOUTUBE_ANALYTICS_SCOPE_MISSING means the user must reconnect YouTube.

account.description: The YouTube account id (channel id) the video was published on: accountId from get_post_metrics rows.

video.description: The YouTube video id: externalId from a youtube get_post_metrics row.

name: get_youtube_retention_curve
